findings.title: TestLogger.FromContext returns a fresh logger, so recorded logs are lost
findings.body: `FromContext` returns `NewTestLogger()`. `LoggerMiddleware.logRequest` now logs through `m.logger.FromContext(ctx).Info(...)`. With this fake, the "Plugin Request Completed" call lands on a throwaway instance. The original `TestLogger`'s `InfoLogs` therefore stays at zero calls, and any test that asserts on those logs will fail or silently stop checking anything. `FromContext` should return the receiver (or a logger that shares its state). No test for `LoggerMiddleware` or the new `ContextualLoggerMiddleware` is added in this PR.

findings.title: New middleware has no tests and does not guard against nil requests
findings.body: `ContextualLoggerMiddleware` takes over the contextual-logger behaviour that used to live in the instrumentation middleware, but no test covers it. That includes the endpoint, pluginId, dsName, dsUID and uname attributes it puts on the context. It also dereferences `req.PluginContext` without a nil check, whereas `LoggerMiddleware` explicitly guards `req == nil`. A nil request now panics here, in the new middleware, instead of passing through.

findings.title: traceID and request attributes now depend on middleware ordering and context-provider behaviour
findings.body: `logRequest` used to add `pluginId`, `endpoint`, `uname`, `dsName`, `dsUID` and `traceID` explicitly. It now relies entirely on `m.logger.FromContext(ctx)` picking up attributes set by `ContextualLoggerMiddleware`, plus traceID from the context. If `FromContext` fails the type assertion to `*log.ConcreteLogger`, the wrapper falls back to `d.New()`. That fallback is a plain logger, so the request log silently loses all of these fields. `LoggerMiddleware` depends on `ContextualLoggerMiddleware` running earlier, and nothing enforces that ordering; the dependency is only implicit in the middleware list in `CreateMiddlewares`. No test verifies that the emitted log still carries the same fields as before.

findings.title: Adding FromContext to the exported Logger interface breaks other implementers
findings.body: `FromContext` is a new required method on the public `plog.Logger` interface. Any other implementation of this interface (mocks or logger wrappers in other packages or enterprise code) will stop compiling. The PR only updates `TestLogger` and the infra wrapper. The change is also not mentioned in the PR description.
